entries.source: VIP Speed Boat Tour in Alanya. Private luxury speed boat experience for up to 8 guests. 90 minutes on the Mediterranean Sea with guidance, insurance and transfer from selected areas. From €300.
entries.translation: VIP Speed Boat Tour in Alanya. Private luxury speed boat experience for up to 8 guests. 90 minutes on the Mediterranean Sea with guidance, insurance and transfer from selected areas. From €300.

entries.source: Private luxury speed boat experience on the Mediterranean Sea

entries.source: Enjoy a premium 90-minute speed boat tour in Alanya with a private group of up to 8 guests. Feel the power of the sea, enjoy the coastline, swim in beautiful waters and experience a luxury boat ride with professional safety support.
entries.translation: Enjoy a premium 90-minute speed boat tour in Alanya with a private group of up to 8 guests. Feel the power of the sea, enjoy the coastline, swim in beautiful waters and experience a luxury boat ride with professional safety support.

entries.source: VIP Speed Boat Tour is a private 90-minute sea experience for groups of up to eight guests.
entries.translation: VIP Speed Boat Tour is a private 90-minute sea experience for groups of up to eight guests.

entries.source: The boat is reserved for your group, creating a more personal atmosphere than a shared excursion. The route and speed are adjusted by the captain according to sea conditions, local restrictions and the selected time slot.
entries.translation: The boat is reserved for your group, creating a more personal atmosphere than a shared excursion. The route and speed are adjusted by the captain according to sea conditions, local restrictions and the selected time slot.

entries.source: A swimming stop may be included when conditions and timing allow. It is not guaranteed at a specific bay, and the captain makes the final safety decision.
entries.translation: A swimming stop may be included when conditions and timing allow. It is not guaranteed at a specific bay, and the captain makes the final safety decision.

entries.source: The listed price is for the private boat session, not per person. Advance reservation is recommended, especially for sunset and summer time slots.
entries.translation: The listed price is for the private boat session, not per person. Advance reservation is recommended, especially for sunset and summer time slots.
